Summary: Your PC is taking longer to start, especially after a recent Steam-related change.
likely_cause: Steam and its associated startup items are slowing down the boot process.
Evidence: The startup time increased to 152 seconds on Saturday, matching a recent Steam install.
Steam and two related items were added to startup on Wednesday.
No resource spikes or crashes were recorded during the boot period.
Previous startup times were normal until the Steam change.
Steps: Open Task Manager and go to the 'Startup' tab.
Find Steam or any related items listed there.
Right-click each and select 'Disable' to stop them from starting with Windows.
Restart your PC to see if the startup time improves.
